description_en:
● Adds product information for a business party.
● After a successful import, the platform returns a globally unique platform_item_id for subsequent updates and recognition result association.
● If item_unique_id is duplicated within the same business party, the platform returns conflict information
description_zh:
● 用于业务方新增商品信息。
● 导入成功后，平台返回全局唯一的 platform_item_id，供后续更新和识别结果关联使用。
● 同一业务方下，item_unique_id 重复时，平台应返回冲突信息
kebab_example: aliyun agentretailvision import-products --item-unique-id ITEM_001 --image-title '可口可乐330ml' --main-image https://img.example.com/item1.jpg --multi-view-images Angle=up Url=https://img5-parcel.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/2026/01/12/78568805914464s.jpeg007 --extra-images https://img.example.com/item1.jpg --device-id DEVICE_001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportProducts

parameters.help_en: The product ID assigned by the business party. This ID must be unique within the same business party
parameters.help_zh: 业务方商品ID，同一业务方下唯一
parameters.name: item_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The list of main product image URLs. At least one image is required
parameters.help_zh: 商品主图图片 URL 列表，至少 1 张
parameters.name: main_image

element_fields.help_en: The OSS URL of the image
element_fields.name: url

element_fields.help_en:
The shooting angle. Valid values are listed in the following table.
| angle value | Description | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `up` | Top view | An image taken from above the product |
| `down` | Bottom view | An image taken from below the product |
| `left` | Left view | An image taken from the left side of the product |
| `right` | Right view | An image taken from the right side of the product |
| `front` | Front view | An image taken from the front of the product |
| `back` | Back view | An image taken from the back of the product |
element_fields.help_zh:
拍摄角度，取值见下表
| angle 取值 | 含义 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `up` | 上视图 | 从商品上方拍摄的图片 |
| `down` | 下视图 | 从商品下方拍摄的图片 |
| `left` | 左视图 | 从商品左侧拍摄的图片 |
| `right` | 右视图 | 从商品右侧拍摄的图片 |
| `front` | 前视图 | 从商品正面拍摄的图片 |
| `back` | 后视图 | 从商品背面拍摄的图片 |
element_fields.name: angle

parameters.help_en: The list of multi-angle product images
parameters.name: multi_view_images

parameters.help_en: The list of additional image URLs that can be provided
parameters.help_zh: 其余可提供的图片 URL 列表
parameters.name: extra_images

parameters.help_en: The device ID, used to establish an association between the device and product vectors
parameters.help_zh: 设备号，用于建立设备商品向量关联
parameters.name: device_id
